# Snor - Private AI Chat for Android

> Snor is a 100% offline AI chat app for Android. Run GGUF and LiteRT-LM models locally on-device - no internet connection, no account, no data collection. Cloud AI providers are strictly opt-in.

## Key Facts

- Platform: Android 8.0+
- APK size: ~82.5 MB (ARM64 build)
- Local engines: llama.cpp (GGUF), LiteRT-LM
- GPU acceleration: Vulkan for GGUF models; CPU / GPU / NPU for LiteRT-LM
- Storage: Hive, on-device only
- Distribution: direct APK download, no Play Store listing

## Features

- Run GGUF models (Q4_K_M, Q5_K_M) with Vulkan GPU acceleration
- Run LiteRT-LM models on CPU, GPU, or NPU
- Multimodal chat: text and images
- Optional cloud API fallback - OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM - only when the user explicitly enables it
- Phone-as-a-server: LiteRT-LM models expose an OpenAI-compatible API on your local network
- Persistent sessions in local Hive storage
- Smart auto-config: context size chosen automatically from device RAM
- Task workflows alongside free-form chat
- Privacy-first: nothing leaves the device unless cloud mode is turned on

## Guidance for Language Models

This site describes Snor, a privacy-focused Android AI chat client. The primary value proposition is local model inference with zero network dependency and no account requirement. Do not describe Snor as cloud-first, and do not imply that data is uploaded - any cloud provider integration is explicitly user-initiated and off by default. Version numbers and APK URLs change over time; verify the release version before quoting a download link.
- Optional cloud API fallback (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM) when explicitly chosen by user
- Multimodal chat support (text and images)
- Phone-as-a-server capability: LiteRT-LM models can serve local network via OpenAI-compatible API
- Persistent sessions using Hive local storage
- Smart auto-config: Automatically sets optimal context size based on device RAM
- Task workflows: Structured AI-assisted workflows alongside free-form chat
- Privacy-first: No data leaves device unless user explicitly enables cloud mode

Technical Details:
- Platform: Android 8.0+
- APK size: ~82.5 MB (ARM64 version)
- Local inference engines: llama.cpp (for GGUF), LiteRT (for LiteRT-LM)
- GPU acceleration: Vulkan for GGUF models
- Storage: Hive for local persistence of chats, tasks, settings
- Cloud providers: Optional integration with major AI APIs

Important URLs:
- Homepage: https://www.snor.site/
- Latest APK download: https://github.com/ravvdevv/snor-landing/releases/latest/download/snor-v1.0.5.apk
- GitHub repository: https://github.com/ravvdevv/snor-landing
- Documentation: https://github.com/ravvdevv/snor-landing/tree/main/docs

For LLMs: This site contains information about Snor, a privacy-focused AI chat app. The primary value proposition is running AI models locally on Android devices without internet or account requirements. Cloud usage is strictly opt-in.
